method: Read-only assertion review followed by new tests; no collection or execution has been performed by this author.
node_expansion: Append [parameter_id] to base_node for every listed parameter_id. An empty array means base_node itself. Fresh collection must confirm every identity.
coverage_claim: Only the specified subclauses. No whole catalogue group is declared covered, passing, or complete.

new_tests.oracle: Valid JSON padded to 262143 and 262144 bytes loads; 262145 rejects; exact bytes define file ID; input is unchanged.
No unbounded metadata read; at most cap+1 detection bytes; oversize rejected before JSON parser.
Copied bytes have equal IDs; reordered/indented equal JSON values have different independently computed IDs.
131072 bytes yields exactly two unpadded full pieces; Unicode filenames and zero/non-UTF8 bytes preserve exact output.
Twelve unique full pieces with distinct edge bytes plus one short binary piece survive deliberately scrambled creation order and misleading lexical names; independent size/hash/bytes agree.
After actual temporary prefix write and injected ENOSPC, availability and old pieces are unchanged; no partial target/temp remains.
Each invalid read/write index rejects without any availability/file mutation.
Isolated final-assembly write/permission/replace/hash failures preserve an unrelated sentinel and every piece, leave no new temporary file, and do not report success.
new_tests.limitation: These are component injections. No process-level no-COMPLETE or successful-overwrite-policy credit.

new_tests.oracle: Metadata generation, hashing, seed validation and concurrent source reads use at most 65536-byte reads; separate handles close; independently expected bytes agree.
Replaced oversize cache file is read with an exact-length-plus-one bound and rejected; only affected availability clears; input bytes unchanged.
new_tests.scope: Added bounded-read acceptance requirement, not claimed explicit original cache-read implementation.

new_tests.oracle: Malformed root/encoding/missing-fields reject with ValueError without mutation.
4095/4096 bytes are read exactly; 4097 is HTTP413 before any body read.
Exact documented 400/411/415 status and zero input consumption.
EOF before Content-Length produces controlled incomplete-body HTTP400.
Case-insensitive application/json with charset reads valid body under existing documented media-type behavior.
Actual encoded success/error bytes match explicit Content-Length, JSON content type and connection-close header.
Announce reads at most65537 bytes and closes handle; 65535/65536-byte valid padded response accepted, 65537 rejected as bad_response.
new_tests.limitation: Injected HTTP response object; not real-network timing evidence.

new_tests.oracle: Each malformed bounded response raises TrackerRequestError(category=bad_response).
A 3001-byte deeply nested JSON input is a controlled bad_response, never an escaped RecursionError.
19.999s live;20/20.001s expired; update recreates exactly one changed endpoint; stop/start leaves one new record.
Actual worker control flow selects delays2,4,10,10,5,2 and exact started/update/error outcome sequence.
new_tests.limitation: Deterministic wait provider. This establishes chosen delays, not real elapsed timing.

new_tests.oracle: Full queue loses one counted event; next announce delivers the new candidate rather than retaining old snapshot.
Worker completion flag during retry results in completed then stopped after successful registration.
new_tests.limitation: Caller is trusted to signal real verified completion; does not establish listener/assembly ordering.

new_tests.oracle: Real HTTP exact size boundary matches status, membership, byte Content-Length and healthy subsequent request; owned thread joins.
Real HTTP invalid request produces documented status, preserves prior member copy, uses actual connection source IPv4 and serves subsequent healthy client.
Disabled structured logging never opens a file.
Every strict JSONL record has exact timestamp/process/event/fields and trailing newline.
Eight local producer threads produce200 unique intact ordered-per-producer records; no missing/duplicate events.
Forced producer lock-order inversion gives monotonically ordered emitted timestamps; sampling before serialization would fail this regression.
Destination change closes previous descriptor and sends each event only to its intended file.
Unwritable missing-parent destination is nonfatal; later valid destination records actual recovery event.
Unserializable field is nonfatal; following valid event forms one intact JSON line; missing event remains missing.
Preserved permissive reader skips malformed records as documented; independent strict parsing rejects same bytes.
Repeated named-logger access has exactly one handler and one actual formatted output line.

remaining_gaps.reason: Duplicate-key and extra-field policies need explicit reviewed per-parser decisions; arbitrary positive generic piece sizes must not be removed to force v1 conformity.
New component injections do not replace real process storage/assembly fault scenarios or establish no-COMPLETE events.
Full symlink/junction/hardlink/reserved-name/source/output alias matrix still needs executable methods and platform resources.
Hostile server incorrect response Content-Length, stalled body/reset, and malformed huge-integer handling remain separately required.
Real listener-before-started, assembly-before-completed, console error rate limit and structured-error completeness need correlated child instrumentation.
Independent verifier, externally retained digest and fresh challenged source-isolated reruns are outside this component-test addition.
Alternate transfer_store, all shared helper/API/export/Protocol branches, installed wheel/sdist and console entrypoints need full ledger closure.
